name: cutter_command
description: Run one arbitrary Rizin command in a selected live Cutter session. Commands may edit and persist analysis state or execute plugin-provided effects; completion uncertainty is returned as Evidence and must not be retried automatically. The authenticated request and response frame is bounded by REA_BRIDGE_MAX_REQUEST_BYTES (default 16777216 bytes, floor 7464, maximum 536870887). The payload budget excludes the terminating LF. An out-of-band Cutter process without the setting uses 16777216 bytes; a mismatch is refused before the command is sent. In a shared MCP server, this admitted command closes any active binary-analysis session; after its effects have settled, call open_binary before further analysis. Close an active Ghidra session explicitly first.
